mechanism: Bumetanide causes hypokalemia and volume depletion which potentiates the hypotensive and negative inotropic effects of atenolol, while loop diuretics may reduce the antihypertensive efficacy and increase risk of electrolyte imbalances.
action: Monitor serum potassium, renal function, and blood pressure regularly; consider potassium supplementation or concurrent potassium-sparing agent; dose adjustment of either agent may be necessary based on clinical response and electrolyte status.
